title: Rabbi Berekhyah HaKohen
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Noach 24. In Tanchuma, Va’era 22, he speaks in Rabbi Chelbo’s name; in Tanchuma, Toledot 2 and Bamidbar 2, Bamidbar Rabbah 1:2 and Pesikta Rabbati, piska “BaYom HaShemini,” he speaks in Rabbi Levi’s name; in Tanchuma, Beshalach 11, in the name of Levi bar Sisi; and in Shemot Rabbah 47, in the name of Rabbi Shmuel.
